The Lagoon Park Trails are among best places to run in Montgomery. The 432-acre park is located in the eastern part of Montgomery, and features ~5 miles of trails, plus other facilities: a golf course, softball complex, tennis courts, a restaurant, & more. Note: mainly shaded — a great option in Montgomery’s hot weather! 

It’s fairly easy trail running, through mature forests, passing some meadows and wetlands. Surfaces are a combination of flat dirt, gravel, and packed clay.

The Lagoon Park Trails are among best places to run in Montgomery. The 432-acre park is located in the eastern part of Montgomery, and features ~5 miles of trails, plus other facilities: a golf course, softball complex, tennis courts, a restaurant, & more. Note: mainly shaded — a great option in Montgomery’s hot weather! 

It’s fairly easy trail running, through mature forests, passing some meadows and wetlands. Surfaces are a combination of flat dirt, gravel, and packed clay.  paths. There’s the 2.4-mile Lagoon Park Trail and 2.2-mile Forest Road Trail. This website shows all the trails, and you can click on the individual trails for more information. 

Scroll Down For Route Maps

Essentials
  • About 5 miles of trails, with several marked loop options
  • Fairly flat
  • Depends on trail chosen
  • Off Gunter Park Drive East or Lagoon Park Drive. There are two parking areas

Other Routes in Mongomery, AL

Blount Cultural Park

Montgomery, AL

Parks
This 175-acre park, home to the the Montgomery Museum of Fine Arts, is a pleasant green space for running. There are a few miles of trails passing through a fairly open landscape, with meadows and a small pond. 
Explore

Montgomery Downtown: Riverfront Park & State Capitol Run

Montgomery, AL

Historic | Near Convention Center | Runseeing
A decent run in downtown Montgomery, exploring Riverfront Park and the Alabama State Capitol. Also several monuments to the Confederacy, the Rosa Parks Bus Stop and Museum.
Explore

Old Cloverdale and Garden District Neighborhoods

Montgomery, AL

Gorgeous Residential | Running Track
These are lovely neighborhoods for running in Montgomery, with tree-lined streets and historic homes. Add on with Alabama State University campus, which also has a running track.
Explore

Auburn University at Montgomery (AUM) Trails

Montgomery, AL

Universities
Some nice running on the campus of the Auburn University at Montgomery. The are color-coded trail "AUM Trail" loops of 1.5 and 1.9 miles.
